review:
Hounds of Hell is an underworld slot where Hellhounds are cash multipliers rather than wilds. At the end of each spin, landed hounds stretch to the top of their reel and show values that are collected from the bottom up and from left to right into a running total above each reel.

Adding hounds contribute 1x to 50x, while multiplying hounds multiply the reel's current total by x2 to x10, so the order they land in matters. The reel totals are added together and multiplied by your bet. Only one hound can land per reel. The cap is 20,000x.
